jobs.title: Founding Director
jobs.summary: Lead client acquisition, technical discovery and delivery for a data and AI practice. Scope engagements, set technical direction and oversee development of client systems and in-house products.

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer
jobs.summary: Built an organisation-wide RAG system letting clients, staff and learners query institutional knowledge. Designed and delivered applied ML and infrastructure modules for the Level 6 apprenticeship, running weekly workshops for 20–40 experienced engineers.

jobs.title: Founder & Sole Engineer
jobs.summary: Designed, built and launched a productivity and wellness app on iOS and Android, taking it from concept to beta with a few hundred active testers to date.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.summary: Led the data engineering team through a large court-case migration, implementing an Apache Iceberg data lake on AWS, PySpark pipelines, live data linkage and services supporting front-end development.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer
jobs.summary: Led a team building a Databricks analytics platform on Azure, provisioning infrastructure with Terraform and integrating data sources through PySpark pipelines to support reliable Power BI dashboards.

jobs.title: Data Scientist, Financial Crime
jobs.summary: Developed and deployed an anti-money laundering tool using anomaly detection and NLP to accelerate investigations. Used daily by 400 analysts, saving £12m annually.

jobs.title: Data Engineer, Payments
jobs.summary: Built a flexible restaurant payouts platform to support cash flow through COVID-19 lockdowns, with Docker deployment and pipelines on AWS and Snowflake.

work.heading: Personal projects
work.hint: click a card to open the write-up

projects.title: Image captioning transformer, deployed
projects.blurb: An encoder–decoder captioner trained from scratch, then packaged so it can actually be called: containerised inference, batched requests, a thin API in front. The interesting part was making the serving path boring.

projects.title: Search engine with two-tower RNNs
projects.blurb: Query and document towers trained on separate encoders, embeddings cached for approximate nearest-neighbour retrieval. Built to see how far a small model gets before you reach for a vector database.

projects.title: Audio transcription with Whisper
projects.blurb: A transcription pipeline around Whisper: chunking, diarisation-friendly output, and a queue so long files don't block the app.

projects.title: Softmax site in TypeScript
projects.blurb: The front end for the company — typed, static, deliberately fast.

projects.title: Serverless pipelines on GCP
projects.blurb: A proof of concept for event-driven ingestion with Cloud Functions and Pub/Sub, all defined in Terraform so it can be torn down as easily as it goes up.

projects.title: A simple CNN
projects.blurb: Convolutions written out longhand, for the sake of understanding rather than accuracy.

projects.title: GPT-2 from scratch
projects.blurb: Reproducing GPT-2 end to end — tokeniser, attention, training loop, the lot — to know exactly where the compute goes.

projects.title: This website
projects.blurb: Static React on GitHub Pages, content driven by JSON so updates are one commit.
